title: Common Irregular Preterites
summary: Learn the most frequent irregular past forms such as fui, tive, fiz, disse, and pude.

sections.heading: High-frequency irregular preterite table
sections.body:
Many essential verbs have irregular preterite stems. These forms are common in conversation and storytelling.

| Infinitive | eu | você/ele/ela | nós | vocês/eles/elas |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| ser/ir | **fui** | **foi** | **fomos** | **foram** |
| ter | **tive** | **teve** | **tivemos** | **tiveram** |
| estar | **estive** | **esteve** | **estivemos** | **estiveram** |
| fazer | **fiz** | **fez** | **fizemos** | **fizeram** |
| poder | **pude** | **pôde** | **pudemos** | **puderam** |
| pôr | **pus** | **pôs** | **pusemos** | **puseram** |
| ver | **vi** | **viu** | **vimos** | **viram** |
| vir | **vim** | **veio** | **viemos** | **vieram** |
| dar | **dei** | **deu** | **demos** | **deram** |

examples.pt: Nós demos um presente para ele.

sections.heading: Meanings that change in the preterite
sections.body: Some irregular verbs have special nuances in the preterite. **Pude** often means managed to/could in that situation; **não pude** means could not. **Soube** means found out; **quis** can mean wanted or was willing.

examples.en: I found out the news today.
He wanted/was willing to talk to you.

sections.heading: Ser and ir share forms
sections.body: In the preterite, **ser** and **ir** have the same forms. Context tells you whether it means 'was/were' or 'went'.

keyPoints: Irregular preterites must be memorized as full paradigms.
Ser and ir have identical preterite forms: fui, foi, fomos, foram.
Pôde has an accent in the ele/ela preterite to distinguish it from present pode.
Saber in the preterite often means 'found out'.
Use context to tell whether fui/foi/fomos/foram means was/were or went.

commonMistakes.note: Temporary state in the past uses estar: esteve.
Preterite of poder in the ele/ela form is pôde.

commonMistakes.wrong: Nós vimos de São Paulo ontem.
commonMistakes.right: Nós viemos de São Paulo ontem.
commonMistakes.note: Vir in the preterite is vim/veio/viemos/vieram; vimos is from ver or present of vir.
